children: Gold prices increased on Sunday, September 20, with the international ounce hitting $4,379.2 for buying and $4,377.6 for selling.
In Egypt, the 24-karat price amounted to EGP 7,302.69 for purchase and EGP 7,238.3 for sale, according to Dahab Masr data at 3:27 PM.
Likewise, the 21-karat gold jumped to EGP 6,390.49 for buying and EGP 6,334.15 for selling.
The 18-karat gold climbed to EGP 5,477.56 for buying and EGP 5,429.27 for selling.
A gold coin recorded EGP 51,123 for purchase and EGP 50,593 for sale.
